'''Bormo''' was a [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] member whose territorial boundaries were being overstepped by his fellow [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. They eventually hired a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] to deliver an ultimatum to Bormo and demand a tribute.<ref name="Crossing the Line" />
